title: Emotiv
summary: San Francisco maker of consumer and research EEG headsets and brain-data software.
bodyHtml:
Emotiv sells EEG headsets and an analysis platform used in research, neuro-marketing and consumer applications.

Its ecosystem of developers and datasets is the main asset, because dry-electrode signal quality is otherwise easy to copy.

Why it matters

  • Consumer EEG headsets
  • Research software platform
  • Developer ecosystem

investmentLens: Private; a low-cost way to track non-invasive BCI adoption.
